_comment: Item-code patterns per classification standard and edition, plus subdivision overlays and the scope a code must be unique in. Read by app.core.item_codes. A code passes when any pattern of its edition (or of the project's subdivision overlay) matches it in full.

gb50500.shared_code_note: A 9-digit national code names the item, not the line; only the 12-digit code with the compiler's suffix must be unique

gb50500@2013.label: GB 50500-2013
gb50500@2013.source: GB 50500-2013 / GB 50854-2013: 9-digit national code, 3-digit bill suffix, supplementary codes 0xB001

gb50500@2024.source: GB/T 50500-2024 via Shanghai application rules 2025, 4.2.5 and 4.2.6; appendix numbering not verified
